Ŋlɔ Hijri ŋkeke aɖe be nàkpɔ Arafah, An-Nahr kple Tashreeq ŋkekewo
Ŋlɔ Hijri ŋkeke si sɔ. Ƒe tso 1300 va ɖo 1600, ɣleti tso 1 vaseɖe 12, ŋkeke tso 1 vaseɖe 30.
Gregorian ƒe nya si sɔ kple: %1$s

Ŋlɔ Hijri ŋkeke ɖesiaɖe (alo nàlé ŋkeke si li fifia ɖe asi) be nàxɔ Hajj ŋkeke siwo le eƒe ƒea me enumake: Arafah Ŋkeke (Dhul-Hijjah 9), An-Nahr Ŋkeke (Dhul-Hijjah 10) kple Tashreeq Ŋkeke (Dhul-Hijjah 11, 12 kple 13), wo dometɔ ɖesiaɖe kple eƒe Gregorian ƒe sɔsɔ kple eƒe nɔƒe ne wotsɔe sɔ kple wò ŋkekea.
Sɔti gãtɔ kekeake: tsi tre ɖe Arafah tso ŋdɔ ga wuieve megbe vaseɖe ɣeɖoto, anɔ kuku ɖem geɖe, takbir kple tahlil. Nyagblɔɖila (PBUH) gblɔ be: "Hajj nye Arafah."
Eid al-Adha: kpe Jamarat al-Aqabah kple kpe gbadzɛ adre, sa vɔa, lũ alo lãe, emegbe nàwɔ Tawaf al-Ifadah kple Sai.
Gbesiagbe gbeƒãɖeɖe si ɖoa ŋku kɔnu si woɖo be woawɔ le eƒe ɣeyiɣi me le Hajj ŋkekewo dzi (8–13 Dhul-Hijjah) dzi na wò
Gbesiagbe gbeƒãɖeɖe si ɖoa ŋku kɔnu si woɖo be woawɔ le eƒe ɣeyiɣi me le Hajj ŋkekewo dzi (8–13 Dhul-Hijjah) dzi na wò
Ŋkeke sia ƒe sunnah: ge ɖe ihram me, ɖo ta Mina eye nàtsi afima zã bliboa, agbugbɔ Talbiyah "Labbayk Allahumma labbayk" agblɔ, eye nàdo gbe ɖa le afima kpuie evɔ màƒo ƒu o.
Kpe Jamarat etɔ̃awo le ŋdɔ ga wuieve megbe: sueawo, emegbe titinatɔwo, emegbe gãawo, kpe gbadzɛ adre ɖesiaɖe esime wole takbir gblɔm, hele kuku ɖem le sueawo kple titinatɔwo yome.

Gbugbɔ kpe kpe Jamarat etɔ̃awo le ŋdɔ ga wuieve megbe abe etsɔ ene. Ame sia ame si di be yeawɔ kaba la ate ŋu adzo le Mina hafi ɣe naɖo to; ame si tsi anyi la, etsia zã me eye wòƒua kpe le ŋkeke etɔ̃agbe.
Kpe Jamarat etɔ̃awo le ŋdɔ ga wuieve megbe, emegbe nàwu Hajj la nu kple gbedoname Tawaf ne èle dzodzom le Makkah. Allah naxɔ wò Hajj.
Tashreeq ƒe ŋkekewo: ŋkeke 3 lia (13 Dhul-Hijjah) .

Hajj kple Umrah ŋuti nyatakaka si me kɔ: gɔmesese kple nyametsotsowo, kɔnu ƒomeviwo, mawaqit, kɔnuawo afɔɖeɖe ɖesiaɖe kple woƒe nunya kple nusi woagblɔ le teƒe ɖesiaɖe, ihram ƒe mɔxexeɖedɔa, kple kukuɖeɖewo. Tia akpa si nèdi be yeaku.

Nyagblɔɖila صلى الله عليه وسلم gblɔ be: “Ŋkɔ blaasieke vɔ enyi le Allah si, ɖeka le sue wu alafa ɖeka, amesiame si axlẽ wo la, age ɖe Paradiso me.” Zi ŋkɔ ɖesiaɖe dzi be nàxlẽ eƒe numeɖeɖe, gɔmesese kple kpeɖodzi bliboa tso Quran la me.
